description: This file defines a CMake function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from aidl files as part of a build process. It includes detailed documentation and commands related to the aidl compilation process.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function that compiles aidl files into source code, supporting configurable parameters such as target directory, aidl binary path, language, include directories, and flags.
